shellRuntime.f808: Once Taurus settles into a place, it rarely wavers. As an earth house ruled by Venus, it has a fine eye for what is beautiful and what is comfortable, and it protects that sense for a long time. It chooses going all the way over going fast.

shellRuntime.f810: Changing something once decided costs a lot of energy. Check now and then whether the situation has already moved while only your method stayed the same.
shellRuntime.f811: Tidy one thing you can touch with your hands — a desk, a wallet, one shelf of the fridge is enough. For Taurus, physical order leads straight to inner order.
shellRuntime.f812: Is there a reason today's money fortune matters especially for Taurus?

shellRuntime.f814: How often is the daily fortune updated?

shellRuntime.f816: Gemini stands where information passes through. As an air house ruled by Mercury, it is skilled at linking people with speech and writing, and the moment it learns one thing it tries connecting it to another. It is also the temperament that finds boredom hardest to bear.
shellRuntime.f817: It adapts to situations quickly. Gemini can open a conversation even among strangers, and has a knack for putting complicated matters into plain words.
shellRuntime.f818: When attention is hooked in several places at once, nothing gets deep. Deciding on one thing to hold onto to the end today reduces the scattering.
shellRuntime.f819: Write down whatever occurs to you, however briefly. Gemini only ever reuses what was actually recorded.
shellRuntime.f820: Why does 'speech' come up so often in the Gemini reading?
shellRuntime.f821: Mercury, the ruler of Gemini, is read as the star governing language, thought, and movement. So a day in this house is often decided in conversations, messages, and documents, and the interpretation naturally centres on that axis.
shellRuntime.f822: What is the difference between a zodiac reading and a Four Pillars reading?

shellRuntime.f824: Cancer is the house that takes what matters inside and guards it. As a water sign ruled by the Moon, its emotional grain is fine, and it remembers for a long time even words others let slip. Inside the hard shell is in fact the softest part.
shellRuntime.f825: It has the power to put those nearby at ease. Reading the mood first and quietly taking care of what is needed is the consideration that makes relationships last.
shellRuntime.f826: Hurt stored up inside comes out all at once later. Saying it while it can still be said small is what ultimately protects the relationship.
shellRuntime.f827: Before sleeping, bring to mind one thing you were grateful for today. In the house of the Moon, how you close a day sets the next day's condition.
shellRuntime.f828: Why is the moon phase shown alongside the Cancer reading?
shellRuntime.f829: Because the Moon rules Cancer. The Moon waxes and wanes on a cycle of about 29.5 days, and the phase shown on this page is the actual astronomical value for that date. Use it to know in advance which days are likely to bring wider emotional swings.
shellRuntime.f830: How should I read it on days when emotions are hard?
shellRuntime.f831: Rather than trying to fix the axis with the low score, we suggest using it to postpone decisions in that area by a day. A reading is not a prophecy but a reference for deciding where to spend less force that day.
shellRuntime.f832: Leo is the one who raises the temperature wherever people gather. As a fire house ruled by the Sun, its very presence is bright, and its ability rises another notch when it is recognised. Generosity and pride grow from the same root.
shellRuntime.f833: It draws people in, and takes responsibility for them once drawn. With little fear of standing in front, a leading position comes naturally.
shellRuntime.f834: On days when recognition comes late, disappointment easily gets exaggerated. Noting once that a lack of response is not a lack of worth keeps the day steadier.
shellRuntime.f835: Say something good about someone else first today. When Leo shares its light, its own light grows with it.
shellRuntime.f836: How should a Leo make use of a good day?
shellRuntime.f837: We suggest gathering the occasions that put you in front of people — presentations, interviews, pitches — onto days with a high overall score. A Leo's actual performance rises when attention is on it, so the same preparation produces a different result.

shellRuntime.f840: Virgo sees the one slot everyone else missed. As an earth house ruled by Mercury, its thinking is concrete, and it chooses to prove itself through the finish of the work rather than through talk. Its standards are high, and it is strictest with itself.

shellRuntime.f844: Is there a reason the Virgo reading emphasises health?
shellRuntime.f845: Virgo is traditionally read as the house governing the digestive and nervous systems and daily routine. Stress tends to show up first in rhythms such as digestion and sleep, so it is useful to treat the health axis as an early signal.
shellRuntime.f846: Does the result match that day's actual calculation exactly?

shellRuntime.f848: Libra speaks only after seeing both sides. As an air house ruled by Venus, it reads the temperature of a relationship precisely and finds the point that leans to neither side. That carefulness can sometimes look like a delayed decision.
shellRuntime.f849: It is outstanding at lowering conflict. Between opposing positions it finds the common ground first and settles the situation from there.
shellRuntime.f850: Trying to satisfy everyone can cost you your own share. Decide one thing today by your own standard.
shellRuntime.f851: Put a time limit on decisions. A single rule — 'choose within ten minutes' — makes a Libra's day considerably lighter.
shellRuntime.f852: What can a Libra do on days when decisions keep getting postponed?
shellRuntime.f853: Reducing the options comes first. Once there are more than three candidates, a Libra's cost of judgement rises sharply. Cutting it to two and setting a time limit picks up speed with almost no loss in the quality of the decision.
shellRuntime.f854: On what basis are the compatible signs decided?
shellRuntime.f855: We use the trine formed among signs of the same element and the opposing sign across the chart. Libra flows well with Gemini and Aquarius, its fellow air signs, and its relationship with Aries opposite is read as each supplying what the other lacks.
shellRuntime.f856: Scorpio does not stop at the surface. Being a water house that also carries the force of Mars, once it digs in it goes all the way. It is the sign that notices what has not been said before it hears what has.
shellRuntime.f857: The depth of its immersion is different. Results come from work that takes a long time, and from work others gave up on. In a crisis it becomes calmer rather than less so.
shellRuntime.f858: Once a heart has closed, it takes a long time to open again. Checking the facts once more before hardening a judgement reduces the loss.
shellRuntime.f859: Close one thing all the way today. What stays unresolved takes the most energy from a Scorpio.
shellRuntime.f860: Why does the word 'regeneration' come up so often in the Scorpio reading?
shellRuntime.f861: Scorpio is traditionally read as the house governing dissolution, regeneration, and deep change. Because ending and beginning again are seen as happening in the same place, the interpretation mentions closure and a fresh start together.
shellRuntime.f862: Can I see tomorrow's fortune in advance too?

shellRuntime.f864: Sagittarius has a wide field of view. As a fire house ruled by Jupiter, it finds narrow frames stifling and aims its arrow at new places and new perspectives. Its optimism is not groundless — it comes from having crossed over many times already.

shellRuntime.f868: How is a Sagittarius best served by the advice of the day?

shellRuntime.f870: How much should I believe a reading?

shellRuntime.f872: Capricorn is not afraid of things that take a long time. As an earth house ruled by Saturn, it trusts rules and structure and holds its post until a visible result arrives. It does not lead with feeling, but it always keeps its word.

shellRuntime.f876: Why should a Capricorn read the day around the work score?
shellRuntime.f877: Saturn, the ruler of Capricorn, is read as the star of responsibility, structure, and time. For this house, work and achievement sit at the centre of self-perception, so the flow of the work score often spills over into love, health, and other areas.
shellRuntime.f878: My birthday is in late December or early January — which sign is that?
shellRuntime.f879: 22 December to 19 January is Capricorn. That said, the moment the Sun changes sign shifts slightly from year to year, so if you were born on a cusp date the calculation needs your birth time to be accurate.
shellRuntime.f880: Aquarius asks questions about what everyone else takes for granted. With the force of Uranus laid over an air house, it steps back from convention and finds new methods at that distance. It looks like individualism, but it is in fact thinking about the whole.

shellRuntime.f882: Keeping the emotional temperature low can leave those close to you feeling hurt. Explain your reasons to one person today.
shellRuntime.f883: Deliberately secure some time alone. Aquarius's ideas come out of the empty hours.
shellRuntime.f884: Why is the love reading for Aquarius different from other signs?
shellRuntime.f885: Aquarius is read as a temperament that maintains closeness from within a distance. So a day with a low love score fits reality better when read as a signal that time alone is needed, rather than as conflict.
shellRuntime.f886: Who writes the readings on this page?
shellRuntime.f887: It is not written by a person each day. It is produced by calculating that day's day pillar and the positions of the celestial bodies and applying them to each sign's temperament. That is why the same day gives the same result whenever you visit.
shellRuntime.f888: Pisces has thin borders. As the last house of the zodiac it carries a little of the grain of the eleven before it, and other people's feelings come in as if they were its own. That sensitivity turns into artistic sense and deep empathy.
shellRuntime.f889: It understands people's hearts well. Where comfort is needed it knows how to pick the right words, and its imagination is rich.

shellRuntime.f892: How should a Pisces spend a day of heavy emotional drain?
shellRuntime.f893: We suggest cutting back on meeting new people or making decisions, and staying inside relationships that are already comfortable. Pisces recovers slowly, but once recovered its intuition becomes remarkably accurate.
shellRuntime.f894: Can I look at the Chinese zodiac reading as well?
shellRuntime.f895: Yes. This site offers all twelve zodiac signs and all twelve zodiac animals. The signs are based on the Sun's position and the animals on the earthly branch of your birth year, so reading both gives you two views that complement each other.
shellRuntime.f896: Zi (子), the first of the twelve branches, is the force of water. Those born in the Year of the Rat read a situation quickly, move first, and gather what they will need in advance. Their sense for detecting risk is sharp, so they tend to avoid large losses.
shellRuntime.f897: They catch information and opportunity ahead of others. Being good at collecting and managing, they build a structure in which wealth accumulates little by little.
shellRuntime.f898: Thinking too much and postponing the decision closes the window of opportunity. Once the calculation is done, move to execution.
shellRuntime.f899: Check what came in and what went out once a day. When the Rat can see the flow with its own eyes, its judgement becomes accurate.
shellRuntime.f900: What are the trine and the clash in the Rat reading?
shellRuntime.f901: A trine (三合) is a set of three branches that lift each other's force. The Rat (Zi) forms the Water trine with the Monkey (Shen) and the Dragon (Chen). A clash (沖) is a head-on relationship: the Rat clashes with the Horse (Wu). A day carrying a clash is not read as a bad day but as a day of large movement.
shellRuntime.f902: How do I find out which animal sign I am?
shellRuntime.f903: Your animal is set by the earthly branch of your birth year, and the boundary is Lichun (the start of spring) in the solar terms, not 1 January. If you were born in January or early February, you may belong to the previous year's animal, so check with the Manseryeok almanac.
shellRuntime.f904: Chou (丑) is the earth at winter's end. Those born in the Year of the Ox push on at their own pace without hurrying, and that steadiness eventually produces results others could not. They do not lead with talk; they prove it with the outcome.
shellRuntime.f905: They carry responsibility to the end. Trust in them runs deep, and the longer they stay in one field the more certain their expertise becomes.
shellRuntime.f906: They find it hard to change a method once decided. If the situation has changed, review the method along with it.
shellRuntime.f907: Write down the order of the work in advance. With a plan standing, the Ox goes without wavering.
shellRuntime.f908: What should an Ox use a good day for?
shellRuntime.f909: We suggest using it to lay the groundwork for something that takes a long time. The Ox's strength shows more clearly in work that accumulates over many days than in work that finishes within one. Contracts, tidying up, and setting a study plan suit it well.
shellRuntime.f910: Does the animal reading change every day?
shellRuntime.f911: Yes. Because that day's day-pillar stem and branch change daily, the reading for each of the twelve animals is recalculated every day. It refreshes at midnight, Korea time.
shellRuntime.f912: Yin (寅) is the force of wood as spring begins. Those born in the Year of the Tiger cannot stand injustice and force open what is blocked. Having little fear, they go first down roads others cannot take.
shellRuntime.f913: They decide fast and drive hard. Having the force to lead people, the front position suits them.
shellRuntime.f914: When momentum rises it is easy to lose sight of those around you. Look back once to check whether you have gone ahead alone.
shellRuntime.f915: When anger rises, take three breaths before speaking. Those three breaths are what keeps the Tiger's relationships.
shellRuntime.f916: Should a Tiger be careful on a day that carries a clash?
shellRuntime.f917: A clash (沖) is less an inauspicious day than a day when movement and friction grow. On a Yin–Shen clash day the Tiger easily meets a large change such as a move or a job switch, so as long as you avoid decisions made in anger, it can just as well become a turning point.
shellRuntime.f918: How does the animal reading differ from Four Pillars?
shellRuntime.f919: The animal reading uses only one branch — that of your birth year — while Four Pillars uses all four pillars of year, month, day, and hour. The animal reading suits looking at the broad flow; Four Pillars suits looking at an individual's concrete board.
shellRuntime.f920: Mao (卯) is the wood of spring in full. Those born in the Year of the Rabbit are soft and finely tuned, and they arrive where they want without colliding. Their aesthetic sense is strong and they put people at ease.
shellRuntime.f921: They make relationships run smoothly. Quick to read a room and flexible with circumstances, they find their place anywhere.
shellRuntime.f922: Avoiding conflict and leaving things unsaid lets them build up inside. Say your own share, even gently.
shellRuntime.f923: Make your surroundings a little prettier. When the environment is in order, the Rabbit's mind settles with it.
shellRuntime.f924: On what days do the Rabbit's relationships go better?
shellRuntime.f925: When the day's branch is the Pig (Hai) or the Goat (Wei), the Wood trine of Hai–Mao–Wei forms and the flow with people softens. Asking a favour or attempting reconciliation on such days often gets through.
shellRuntime.f926: Does checking it every day help?
shellRuntime.f927: Knowing the day's force in advance makes it easier to separate what to push on from what to postpone. Please also keep in mind that a reading is reference material, not a substitute for the decision itself.
shellRuntime.f928: Chen (辰) is the end of spring, earth holding water. Those born in the Year of the Dragon work at scale and are good at enlarging the board; staying in an ordinary place feels stifling. The amplitude of their fortune is wide, so the rises and falls are pronounced too.
shellRuntime.f929: Their presence is strong and they make opportunities big. In a crisis their judgement turns bold.
shellRuntime.f930: The bigger the undertaking, the more easily details leak. Keep someone beside you to hand the finishing to.
shellRuntime.f931: Break a big goal down into one step you can take today. When the first step is concrete, the Dragon's execution follows.
shellRuntime.f932: Why is the Dragon said to have wide swings of fortune?
shellRuntime.f933: Chen (辰) is earth holding water — a branch where forces of different natures gather in one place. So a smooth flow and a blocked one tend to divide sharply, and the interpretation shows a wide amplitude as well.
shellRuntime.f934: Why do results differ between people born in the same Dragon year?
shellRuntime.f935: The animal is only the year branch — one of the four pillars. Even within the same animal, a different month, day, and hour changes the actual board considerably. Reflecting individual differences requires a Four Pillars analysis with your birth date and time.
shellRuntime.f936: Si (巳) is the fire of early summer. Those born in the Year of the Snake finish the calculation inside without showing it outwardly. They speak little, but when they move once they move precisely, and they see straight through people and situations.
shellRuntime.f937: Their judgement is finely made. They gather information and use it at the decisive moment. They do not waver in a crisis.
shellRuntime.f938: Judging alone and then announcing it creates misunderstanding. Share part of the process in advance.
shellRuntime.f939: Write the reason for your decision in one line. When the Snake leaves its own logic behind, its persuasiveness grows.
shellRuntime.f940: Is there a reason the money axis matters for the Snake?
shellRuntime.f941: The Snake (Si) forms the Metal trine together with the Rooster (You) and the Ox (Chou). Metal is the element that stands for harvest and wealth, so days on which this combination holds tend to produce substantial results.
shellRuntime.f942: Is there a best time of day to read it?
shellRuntime.f943: We suggest checking in the morning, before the day starts — using it to adjust that day's schedule is the most practical. The content refreshes at midnight, so it reads the same whenever you open it.
shellRuntime.f944: Wu (午) is the fire of midsummer. Those born in the Year of the Horse send their energy outward and cannot bear being shut in. They brighten the mood among people, and the more they move the more fortune attaches to them.
shellRuntime.f945: They have drive and sociability at once. They start fast and get those around them moving along with them.
shellRuntime.f946: With a foot in several places, nothing ripens. Pour your time into one thing today.
shellRuntime.f947: Actually move your body. Even a short walk is the quickest way for a Horse to put its thoughts in order.
shellRuntime.f948: 2026 is a Horse year — how should I read my own animal's year?

shellRuntime.f950: What should I watch out for on a clash day?
shellRuntime.f951: The Horse clashes with the Rat (Zi) in the Zi–Wu clash. On such days accidents while travelling and emotional arguments arise easily, so simply cutting back on rushed schedules and off-the-cuff answers already changes how the day feels.
shellRuntime.f952: Wei (未) is the earth at summer's end. Those born in the Year of the Goat are gentle and warm-hearted, and they endure for a long time without showing it. Rich in feeling, they have a gift for making and expressing.
